verdict.rationale: Paddle documents four official server-side SDKs (Node.js, Python, Go, PHP). The Node SDK ships TypeScript definitions, pagination and webhook signature helpers, and the Python SDK has a similar documented feature set. Paddle.js covers the client side, and an OpenAPI 3.1 spec is published for generating clients. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and detailed evidence for the Go and PHP SDKs beyond their listing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: We support four official server-side SDKs: Node.js, Python, Go, and PHP.
